technical_and_design_decisions: Implementation will be done primarily in Go, following standard Hyperledger Fabric core architecture and gRPC service definitions.
The Solo ordering service will utilize Go channels for batching transactions into blocks and an in-memory thread-safe data structure for the RAM ledger supporting gRPC Deliver Seek requests.
The CLI commands will be decoupled from CGO / RocksDB dependencies by creating a standalone lightweight Go package that compiles clean native binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Lifecycle System Chaincode (LSCC) will be implemented as an internal system chaincode handling instantiation, policy validation, and chaincode metadata management.
The state cache will be integrated into the peer endorser node execution path using a thread-safe LRU/concurrent cache to speed up read-write set (rw-set) simulation.
assumptions: Development work will be performed by a single developer familiar with Go, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and distributed ledger concepts.
GitHub repository mirroring from Gerrit requires setting up repository structure, CI workflows, and documentation pointers rather than building a custom migration platform.
Documentation hosting on hyperledger.org uses standard Markdown/Sphinx tools and existing publishing infrastructure.
Testing environments for cross-compilation (Windows, macOS, Linux) are readily available.

activities.activity_description: Update chaincode data structures, protobuf definitions, logging, and CLI management interfaces to support friendly naming for chaincode identification and debugging.
Implement LSCC system chaincode routines for managing chaincode lifecycle, deployment policies, endorsement policy checking, and instantiation validation.
Create comprehensive developer documentation, sequence diagrams, and step-by-step guides for chaincode upgrade workflows.

activities.activity_name: Solo Ordering Service and RAM Ledger Implementation
activities.activity_description: Develop the single-process Solo orderer including channel-based batching/block creation, in-RAM ledger storage, and gRPC Deliver service with history seeking capabilities.
Establish public GitHub repository layout, mirroring workflows from Gerrit, README navigation, and developer contribution guidelines for GitHub exploration.

activities.activity_name: Endorser State Cache for RW-Set Construction
activities.activity_description: Design and implement an in-memory state cache for the peer node to optimize state access during transaction simulation and speed up read-write set generation.
Organize application and chaincode developer documentation, configure documentation build scripts, and link docs to hyperledger.org entry points.
Decouple peer CLI commands from validating peer internal dependencies (e.g., RocksDB/CGO), refactor packages, and create build pipelines for standalone binaries on Mac, Windows, and Linux.
Perform end-to-end testing across Solo orderer, LSCC, CLI tools, and state cache to validate system integrity and feature integration.
